ei.title: Oliver's First Day at the New School

fullPassage: Looking around the noisy cafeteria, Oliver gripped his tray tightly. He felt the heavy weight of being new to the school. Not knowing how the day would go made him feel anxious. He sat with a heavy sigh at a corner table. He thought, 'Can I make it through the rest of the day?' Just then, a plastic tray was placed down opposite him. It was a boy from his math class. "Hey, is this seat taken? By the way, thanks for lending me that pen earlier." The invisible wall around Oliver seemed to melt away. "Not at all, please sit," he replied. Starting to feel at ease, he smiled brightly at the boy.

questions.passage: ①<u>Looking</u> around the noisy cafeteria, Oliver gripped his tray ②<u>tight</u>. He felt the heavy weight of ③<u>being</u> new to the school. Not knowing how the day would go made him ④<u>feel</u> anxious.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② tight → tightly: 동사 gripped를 수식하는 부사가 필요.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Looking: 분사구문 — 적절
❌ ② tight → tightly: 동사 수식 부사
✅ ③ being: 전치사 of 뒤 동명사 — 적절
✅ ④ feel: make + O + 동사원형 — 적절
det.tip: 동사 수식은 부사. tight(형용사) → tightly(부사). 단, tight도 부사로 쓰이지만 격식체에서는 tightly가 표준.

questions.passage: Not knowing how the day would go ①<u>made</u> him feel anxious. He sat with a heavy sigh at a corner table. Just then, a plastic tray ②<u>was placed</u> down opposite him. It ③<u>was</u> a boy from his math class. The invisible wall around Oliver seemed ④<u>melting</u> away.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ melting → to melt: seem + to부정사 구조이므로 to부정사가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① made: 동명사 주어 + 단수 동사 — 적절
✅ ② was placed: 수동태 — 적절
✅ ③ was: It was a boy — 적절
❌ ④ melting → to melt: seem + to V
det.tip: seem + to V = ~인 것 같다. seem -ing 형태는 불가.

det.korean: 긴장이 풀리며 편안함(ease)을 느끼기 시작했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② ease(편안함): at ease = 편안한
❌ ① risk(위험): 반대 어감

❌ ④ home(집): 어색

det.korean: ③ build(쌓다) → melt(녹다): 친구가 다가오자 심리적 장벽이 '쌓이는' 것이 아니라 '녹아 사라지는' 맥락이다.
